rationale: Authenticates retained current-run tooling/browser job receipts after partial CI reruns without renaming source attempts, weakening full/fresh checks or changing product behavior.

summary.ru: Паспорт частичного CI rerun сохраняет исходную попытку и проверяет реальное исполнение retained job.
summary.en: Partial CI rerun receipts preserve the source attempt and authenticate the retained job execution.
